component.name: Dendro
component.summary: Visual package manager and dependency hierarchy explorer

description.p: Dendro is a modern graphical package manager and visual dependency hierarchy explorer built specifically for Fedora Linux.

ul.li: Interactive multi-level dependency trees with cycle detection
Smart package classification (User apps, Core pillars, Libraries, Orphans)
Native privileged execution with Polkit and DNF/DNF5
Dry-run transaction simulation and DNF history explorer

screenshot.caption: Main tree view exploring package dependencies and queued operations

description.p: Major architectural and performance release featuring native bindings and system protection:

ul.li: Integrated native librpm and libdnf5 Python bindings for zero-subprocess queries and rapid tree indexing.
Two-tier L1 RAM and L2 SQLite WAL caching for high-speed dependency and provider resolution.
In-memory transaction dry-run simulation with automatic warnings when Fedora core pillars (kernel, glibc, systemd, desktop environment) are queued for removal.
Strict classification engine separating desktop apps, command-line utilities, programming runtimes, and system libraries.
Refined AppImage runtime isolation ensuring host RPM and DNF transactions run in an uncontaminated environment.
Fixed headless package validation in isolated mock buildroots.

description.p: Production release of Dendro package manager for Fedora Linux.
